front_matter.preface: Pa o Kamata Isha mai Jesu Christawui Khararchan: Luke Kahona Kasan (The Gospel According to St. Luke in Tangkhul Naga), translated by Rev. William Pettigrew. Published in London by the British and Foreign Bible Society in 1905; printed at the Baptist Mission Press, Calcutta. Contains the narrative of the Nativity, the Sermon on the Plain, and the parables of the Good Samaritan and the Prodigal Son in the Ukhrul vernacular.

chapters.title: Theophilusli Kakhayao kala Marywui La (Preface and Magnificat)
chapters.summary: Dedication to Theophilus, the annunciation by Gabriel to Zacharias and Mary, and Mary's song of praise.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Theophilus mathilakha, Ina maram kachiva kaphung-kachungli theikasomda nawui vang kaphika mathaikha theisai. Kachisona hosa: Zacharias, macharanlu; nawui khangamor chi khanashosai, kala nawui shanao Elisabethna mayar akhat zatlikha. Maryna hosa: Iwui malungna Mapaoli mathan-kashei salikha, kala iwui manganna iwui Haring Kashei Varivarali kaphung phungsai. Pangmashan phungna iwui vang ot kaphung kasada, Awui min Katharasai.
chapters.english_translation: It seemed good to me also, most excellent Theophilus, to write unto thee in order. The angel said: Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son. And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord, and my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour. For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

vocabulary.meaning: He that is mighty, the Almighty One

chapters.grammar_notes: The negative imperative prefix 'ma-' combined with verbal stem '-charan' forms 'macharanlu' (do not fear).

exercises.question: To whom did Luke address his Gospel in Tangkhul?
Translate Mary's opening verse of the Magnificat into English.

chapters.title: Jesuwui Phankahai Bethlehem Shongli (The Nativity)
chapters.summary: The decree of Caesar Augustus, the birth in Bethlehem, and the angelic message to the shepherds.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Zingkum chiwui thotli Caesar Augustus-wui tuingashit kaphung ngalei pamkhapeida min khangashan shoksai. Josephna Davidwui shim kala kachung thotsada Galilee ram Nazarethwui Judea ram Bethlehem shongli zangsai. Chili pammali shit kashikbingna thot khangaso ngasophun sayatli ngayon-kasa pamsai. Kachisona hosa: Macharanlu; Ina nithumli miwung kachivawui kaphung kachang pao kaphung phungsai! Tangkham chili Davidwui ramli Haring Kashei Christa Mapao phankahaisai.
chapters.english_translation: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed. And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem. And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. And the angel said: Unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
chapters.grammar_notes: Temporal adverbial clause 'Zingkum chiwui thotli' marks historical framing (in those days).

exercises.question: What Roman ruler issued the census decree?
How did the angels address the shepherds in Tangkhul?

chapters.title: Jordan Kongli Baptisma (Baptism at Jordan)
chapters.summary: John the Baptist's preaching of repentance in the wilderness and the baptism of Jesus at the river Jordan.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Johnna Jordan kongwui pammali rada kasha-kashan kazangwui baptisma khangayei pao phungsai. Johnna ngahanda hosa: Ina tarana baptisma khayao thotsai; kha Iwui saphunga pangmashan phung akhat raranglikha; Aya Mangan Kathara kala meina baptisma salikha. Mi kachivana baptisma khayaoli Jesu-kha baptisma sayaosai; kala A khangamorli kazing phangshoksai, kala kazingwui tui shoksai: Nana Iwui Mayar Kongashi thotsai.
chapters.english_translation: John came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins. John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire. Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

vocabulary.meaning: to baptize with water, ritual immersion
fire, flame of judgment and purification

chapters.grammar_notes: Instrumental postposition '-na' appears in 'tarana' (with water) and 'meina' (with fire).

exercises.question: What two elements of baptism did John contrast?
What words were spoken from heaven at Jesus' baptism?

chapters.title: Nazarethli Kashung Ot (The Ministry in Nazareth)
chapters.summary: The reading of the Isaiah scroll in the synagogue at Nazareth and preaching deliverance to the captives.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Kala A Nazareth shongli zangsai, chili A kashung pamsai; Sabbath thangli synagogue shimli zangda tui kaphika phashoksai: Mapaowui Mangan Iwui kachungli leisai, maramchilu Aya ningzanbingli pao kaphung kaphan chitheikahai thotsai; A Ili kachiso kazatbingli thotkhamatei kala khararkashanbingli haring khami vangna. Kala A Capernaum shongli zangsai, kala Sabbath thangli athumli tuitam chitheisai; Awui tui pangmashan phungsai.
chapters.english_translation: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read. The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives. And he came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days. And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

vocabulary.meaning: house of prayer, Jewish meeting hall
the poor, the humble and afflicted

chapters.grammar_notes: Postposition '-wui vangna' denotes teleological purpose: 'haring khami vangna' (for the purpose of granting life).

exercises.question: What passage of scripture did Jesus read in Nazareth?
Identify the four groups blessed in the Nazareth manifesto.

chapters.title: Samaria Miwung Phakazang (The Good Samaritan)
chapters.summary: The parable of the man who fell among thieves on the Jericho road and the compassionate Samaritan stranger.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Jesuna hosa: Mi akhat Jerusalem shongwui Jericho shongli vangasai; kala aya rari-kapangbingwui pangli kaphan theisai. Athumna awui kachon khangashan kala thotkhamatei kasada ali marikha-thida vangasai. Pung-kashang akhat shongfa chili vangasai; aya theida shong kacheili vangasai. Kha Samaria mi akhatna zatli aya ali rasai; kala aya ali theida ning-kongashi phungsai. Aya rada awui khazatli thao kala khamarao teikahai, kala pangkaso phungda hotel shimli phung-zangsai. Hiwui thum chili khipana rari-kapangbingwui pangli kaphanchiwui ngacham-mi thotsa naningkha? Aya hosa: Ali kongashi kachithei chi. Jesuna hosa: Zattu, nankha chithata salu!
chapters.english_translation: A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead. And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side. But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him, and went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him. Which now of these three was neighbour unto him? He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
chapters.grammar_notes: The compound idiomatic phrase 'ning-kongashi' signifies visceral heart compassion (malungwui kongashi).

exercises.question: What two travelers passed by the wounded man before the Samaritan?
How did Jesus define 'ngacham-mi' (neighbour) in this parable?

chapters.title: Mayar Kashingashimanwui Wari (The Prodigal Son)
chapters.summary: The parable of the lost younger son, his journey to a far country, repentance, and the father's joyous feast.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Kala A hosa: Mi akhatli mayar khikakhana leisai. Ngachonchi avana hosa: Ava, nawui lungli iwui share phunkami khalu. Thang khakhanali ngachonchi kachiva phungda ram kachang akhatli vangasai, chili aya awui kashak kachiva shiman-hailsai. Aya ning khangasholi hosa: Iwui ava-wui shimli ot-kashabing kachiva raruikatha kaping leisai, kha ina hili ngaraoda thilikha! Ina ngakarangda iwui ava shongli zanglikha kala ali holikha: Ava, ina kazingram kala nawui phungli kakhama sakahaisai. Kha aya kachangli leisalilha avana theida ning-kongashi phungda katda chikhurli phumsai.
chapters.english_translation: A certain man had two sons. And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living. And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living. And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger! I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee. And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

vocabulary.meaning: two sons, pair of male siblings
embraced upon the neck, kissed warmly

chapters.grammar_notes: Temporal correlative 'leisalilha' (while still being far off) expresses anticipatory parental vigil.

exercises.question: What request did the younger son make of his father?
What phrase translates 'when he came to himself' in Tangkhul?

chapters.title: Emmaus Shongwui Zatkatha (The Road to Emmaus)
chapters.summary: The risen Christ walking unrecognized with two disciples on the Emmaus road and revealing Himself in the breaking of bread.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Thang chili athum ngachaiwui khani Jerusalem shongwui Emmaus kahona ramli zattangsai. Kala athumna hiwui maram kachiva ngatei-tui kasai. Athum tui ngateili Jesu amana athumli phakazangda ngasoda vangasai. Kala A athum ngasoda pamsai; A raruikatha phungda mathankashakda kashai chitharan athum theiphunsai! Kala athumna hosa: Shongfali A ithumli tui hoda scripture chitheikahai thotli ithumwui malung mei katha kazang masasakha?
chapters.english_translation: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs. And they talked together of all these things which had happened. And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them. And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them. And their eyes were opened, and they knew him. And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

vocabulary.meaning: to discuss, converse mutually on deep matters
burning like fire, inflamed with conviction

chapters.grammar_notes: The rhetorical interrogative suffix '-sakha' poses the reflective question: 'masasakha?' (did it not burn?).

exercises.question: At what exact moment did the disciples recognize Jesus at Emmaus?
How did the disciples describe their hearts burning within them?

Summary: Dedication to Theophilus, the annunciation by Gabriel to Zacharias and Mary, and Mary's song of praise.

lines: CHAPTER 1 STUDY GUIDE & EXERCISES
VOCABULARY:

- The negative imperative prefix 'ma-' combined with verbal stem '-charan' forms 'macharanlu' (do not fear).

pages.header: Chapter 2: Jesuwui Phankahai Bethlehem Shongli (The Nativity) (Page 7)
pages.title: Chapter 2: Jesuwui Phankahai Bethlehem Shongli (The Nativity)
lines: CHAPTER 2: JESUWUI PHANKAHAI BETHLEHEM SHONGLI (THE NATIVITY)
Summary: The decree of Caesar Augustus, the birth in Bethlehem, and the angelic message to the shepherds.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Zingkum chiwui thotli Caesar Augustus-wui tuingashit kaphung ngalei
pamkhapeida min khangashan shoksai. Josephna Davidwui shim kala kachung
thotsada Galilee ram Nazarethwui Judea ram Bethlehem shongli zangsai.
Chili pammali shit kashikbingna thot khangaso ngasophun sayatli ngayon-
kasa pamsai. Kachisona hosa: Macharanlu; Ina nithumli miwung kachivawui
kaphung kachang pao kaphung phungsai! Tangkham chili Davidwui ramli
Haring Kashei Christa Mapao phankahaisai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from
Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed. And Joseph also went
up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city
of David, which is called Bethlehem. And there were in the same country
shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
And the angel said: Unto you is born this day in the city of David a
Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

pages.header: Chapter 3: Jordan Kongli Baptisma (Baptism at Jordan) (Page 10)
pages.title: Chapter 3: Jordan Kongli Baptisma (Baptism at Jordan)
lines: CHAPTER 3: JORDAN KONGLI BAPTISMA (BAPTISM AT JORDAN)
Summary: John the Baptist's preaching of repentance in the wilderness and the baptism of Jesus at the river Jordan.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Johnna Jordan kongwui pammali rada kasha-kashan kazangwui baptisma
khangayei pao phungsai. Johnna ngahanda hosa: Ina tarana baptisma khayao
thotsai; kha Iwui saphunga pangmashan phung akhat raranglikha; Aya
Mangan Kathara kala meina baptisma salikha. Mi kachivana baptisma
khayaoli Jesu-kha baptisma sayaosai; kala A khangamorli kazing
phangshoksai, kala kazingwui tui shoksai: Nana Iwui Mayar Kongashi
thotsai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
John came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of
repentance for the remission of sins. John answered, saying unto them
all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh: he
shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire. Now when all the
people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized,
and praying, the heaven was opened, and a voice came from heaven, which
said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

Mi kachivana baptisma khayaoli Jesu-kha baptisma sayaosai; kala A khangamorli kazing phangshoksai, kala kazingwui tui shoksai: Nana Iwui Mayar Kongashi thotsai.

pages.header: Chapter 4: Nazarethli Kashung Ot (The Ministry in Nazareth) (Page 12)
pages.title: Chapter 4: Nazarethli Kashung Ot (The Ministry in Nazareth)
lines: CHAPTER 4: NAZARETHLI KASHUNG OT (THE MINISTRY IN NAZARETH)
Summary: The reading of the Isaiah scroll in the synagogue at Nazareth and preaching deliverance to the captives.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Kala A Nazareth shongli zangsai, chili A kashung pamsai; Sabbath thangli
synagogue shimli zangda tui kaphika phashoksai: Mapaowui Mangan Iwui
kachungli leisai, maramchilu Aya ningzanbingli pao kaphung kaphan
chitheikahai thotsai; A Ili kachiso kazatbingli thotkhamatei kala
khararkashanbingli haring khami vangna. Kala A Capernaum shongli
zangsai, kala Sabbath thangli athumli tuitam chitheisai; Awui tui
pangmashan phungsai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his
custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up
for to read. The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed
me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the
brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives. And he came down
to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

Kala A Capernaum shongli zangsai, kala Sabbath thangli athumli tuitam chitheisai; Awui tui pangmashan phungsai.

pages.header: Chapter 5: Samaria Miwung Phakazang (The Good Samaritan) (Page 14)
pages.title: Chapter 5: Samaria Miwung Phakazang (The Good Samaritan)
lines: CHAPTER 5: SAMARIA MIWUNG PHAKAZANG (THE GOOD SAMARITAN)
Summary: The parable of the man who fell among thieves on the Jericho road and the compassionate Samaritan stranger.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Jesuna hosa: Mi akhat Jerusalem shongwui Jericho shongli vangasai; kala
aya rari-kapangbingwui pangli kaphan theisai. Athumna awui kachon
khangashan kala thotkhamatei kasada ali marikha-thida vangasai. Pung-
kashang akhat shongfa chili vangasai; aya theida shong kacheili
vangasai. Kha Samaria mi akhatna zatli aya ali rasai; kala aya ali
theida ning-kongashi phungsai. Aya rada awui khazatli thao kala khamarao
teikahai, kala pangkaso phungda hotel shimli phung-zangsai. Hiwui thum
chili khipana rari-kapangbingwui pangli kaphanchiwui ngacham-mi thotsa
naningkha? Aya hosa: Ali kongashi kachithei chi. Jesuna hosa: Zattu,
nankha chithata salu!
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among
thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and
departed, leaving him half dead. And by chance there came down a certain
priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he
saw him, he had compassion on him, and went to him, and bound up his
wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and brought him to an inn, and took
care of him. Which now of these three was neighbour unto him? He that
shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

pages.header: Chapter 6: Mayar Kashingashimanwui Wari (The Prodigal Son) (Page 17)
pages.title: Chapter 6: Mayar Kashingashimanwui Wari (The Prodigal Son)
lines: CHAPTER 6: MAYAR KASHINGASHIMANWUI WARI (THE PRODIGAL SON)
Summary: The parable of the lost younger son, his journey to a far country, repentance, and the father's joyous feast.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Kala A hosa: Mi akhatli mayar khikakhana leisai. Ngachonchi avana hosa:
Ava, nawui lungli iwui share phunkami khalu. Thang khakhanali ngachonchi
kachiva phungda ram kachang akhatli vangasai, chili aya awui kashak
kachiva shiman-hailsai. Aya ning khangasholi hosa: Iwui ava-wui shimli
ot-kashabing kachiva raruikatha kaping leisai, kha ina hili ngaraoda
thilikha! Ina ngakarangda iwui ava shongli zanglikha kala ali holikha:
Ava, ina kazingram kala nawui phungli kakhama sakahaisai. Kha aya
kachangli leisalilha avana theida ning-kongashi phungda katda chikhurli
phumsai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
A certain man had two sons. And the younger of them said to his father,
Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided
unto them his living. And not many days after the younger son gathered
all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted
his substance with riotous living. And when he came to himself, he said,
How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare,
and I perish with hunger! I will arise and go to my father, and will say
unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee. And he
arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his
father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and
kissed him.

pages.header: Chapter 7: Emmaus Shongwui Zatkatha (The Road to Emmaus) (Page 19)
pages.title: Chapter 7: Emmaus Shongwui Zatkatha (The Road to Emmaus)
lines: CHAPTER 7: EMMAUS SHONGWUI ZATKATHA (THE ROAD TO EMMAUS)
Summary: The risen Christ walking unrecognized with two disciples on the Emmaus road and revealing Himself in the breaking of bread.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Thang chili athum ngachaiwui khani Jerusalem shongwui Emmaus kahona
ramli zattangsai. Kala athumna hiwui maram kachiva ngatei-tui kasai.
Athum tui ngateili Jesu amana athumli phakazangda ngasoda vangasai. Kala
A athum ngasoda pamsai; A raruikatha phungda mathankashakda kashai
chitharan athum theiphunsai! Kala athumna hosa: Shongfali A ithumli tui
hoda scripture chitheikahai thotli ithumwui malung mei katha kazang
masasakha?
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus,
which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs. And they talked
together of all these things which had happened. And it came to pass,
that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew
near, and went with them. And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with
them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them. And
their eyes were opened, and they knew him. And they said one to another,
Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way,
and while he opened to us the scriptures?

Kala athumna hosa: Shongfali A ithumli tui hoda scripture chitheikahai thotli ithumwui malung mei katha kazang masasakha?

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 1: Theophilusli Kakhayao kala Marywui La (Preface and Magnificat)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Theophilus mathilakha, Ina maram kachiva kaphung-kachungli theikasomda nawui vang kaphika mathaikha theisai. Kachisona hosa: Zacharias, macharanlu; nawui khangamor chi khanashosai, kala nawui shanao Elisabethna mayar akhat zatlikha. Maryna hosa: Iwui malungna Mapaoli mathan-kashei salikha, kala iwui manganna iwui Haring Kashei Varivarali kaphung phungsai. Pangmashan phungna iwui vang ot kaphung kasada, Awui min Katharasai.
excerpts.translation_en: It seemed good to me also, most excellent Theophilus, to write unto thee in order. The angel said: Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son. And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord, and my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour. For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 2: Jesuwui Phankahai Bethlehem Shongli (The Nativity)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Zingkum chiwui thotli Caesar Augustus-wui tuingashit kaphung ngalei pamkhapeida min khangashan shoksai. Josephna Davidwui shim kala kachung thotsada Galilee ram Nazarethwui Judea ram Bethlehem shongli zangsai. Chili pammali shit kashikbingna thot khangaso ngasophun sayatli ngayon-kasa pamsai. Kachisona hosa: Macharanlu; Ina nithumli miwung kachivawui kaphung kachang pao kaphung phungsai! Tangkham chili Davidwui ramli Haring Kashei Christa Mapao phankahaisai.
excerpts.translation_en: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed. And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem. And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. And the angel said: Unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 3: Jordan Kongli Baptisma (Baptism at Jordan)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Johnna Jordan kongwui pammali rada kasha-kashan kazangwui baptisma khangayei pao phungsai. Johnna ngahanda hosa: Ina tarana baptisma khayao thotsai; kha Iwui saphunga pangmashan phung akhat raranglikha; Aya Mangan Kathara kala meina baptisma salikha. Mi kachivana baptisma khayaoli Jesu-kha baptisma sayaosai; kala A khangamorli kazing phangshoksai, kala kazingwui tui shoksai: Nana Iwui Mayar Kongashi thotsai.
excerpts.translation_en: John came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins. John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire. Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 4: Nazarethli Kashung Ot (The Ministry in Nazareth)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Kala A Nazareth shongli zangsai, chili A kashung pamsai; Sabbath thangli synagogue shimli zangda tui kaphika phashoksai: Mapaowui Mangan Iwui kachungli leisai, maramchilu Aya ningzanbingli pao kaphung kaphan chitheikahai thotsai; A Ili kachiso kazatbingli thotkhamatei kala khararkashanbingli haring khami vangna. Kala A Capernaum shongli zangsai, kala Sabbath thangli athumli tuitam chitheisai; Awui tui pangmashan phungsai.
excerpts.translation_en: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read. The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives. And he came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days. And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 5: Samaria Miwung Phakazang (The Good Samaritan)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Jesuna hosa: Mi akhat Jerusalem shongwui Jericho shongli vangasai; kala aya rari-kapangbingwui pangli kaphan theisai. Athumna awui kachon khangashan kala thotkhamatei kasada ali marikha-thida vangasai. Pung-kashang akhat shongfa chili vangasai; aya theida shong kacheili vangasai. Kha Samaria mi akhatna zatli aya ali rasai; kala aya ali theida ning-kongashi phungsai. Aya rada awui khazatli thao kala khamarao teikahai, kala pangkaso phungda hotel shimli phung-zangsai. Hiwui thum chili khipana rari-kapangbingwui pangli kaphanchiwui ngacham-mi thotsa naningkha? Aya hosa: Ali kongashi kachithei chi. Jesuna hosa: Zattu, nankha chithata salu!
excerpts.translation_en: A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead. And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side. But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him, and went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him. Which now of these three was neighbour unto him? He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 6: Mayar Kashingashimanwui Wari (The Prodigal Son)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Kala A hosa: Mi akhatli mayar khikakhana leisai. Ngachonchi avana hosa: Ava, nawui lungli iwui share phunkami khalu. Thang khakhanali ngachonchi kachiva phungda ram kachang akhatli vangasai, chili aya awui kashak kachiva shiman-hailsai. Aya ning khangasholi hosa: Iwui ava-wui shimli ot-kashabing kachiva raruikatha kaping leisai, kha ina hili ngaraoda thilikha! Ina ngakarangda iwui ava shongli zanglikha kala ali holikha: Ava, ina kazingram kala nawui phungli kakhama sakahaisai. Kha aya kachangli leisalilha avana theida ning-kongashi phungda katda chikhurli phumsai.
excerpts.translation_en: A certain man had two sons. And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living. And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living. And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger! I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee. And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

excerpts.chapter: Chapter 7: Emmaus Shongwui Zatkatha (The Road to Emmaus)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Thang chili athum ngachaiwui khani Jerusalem shongwui Emmaus kahona ramli zattangsai. Kala athumna hiwui maram kachiva ngatei-tui kasai. Athum tui ngateili Jesu amana athumli phakazangda ngasoda vangasai. Kala A athum ngasoda pamsai; A raruikatha phungda mathankashakda kashai chitharan athum theiphunsai! Kala athumna hosa: Shongfali A ithumli tui hoda scripture chitheikahai thotli ithumwui malung mei katha kazang masasakha?
excerpts.translation_en: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs. And they talked together of all these things which had happened. And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them. And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them. And their eyes were opened, and they knew him. And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
